name: WOOD IN THE PUMPUM
description:
Straight outta yard wid pure tease — $PUMPUM carry di sound an di sweetness of Jamaica. Reggae fi di romance, trap fi di rudeness, an di wood always know weh di pum pum deh. Dis a wi culture, wi riddim, wi big-people business, all inna one likkle coin.

So mek wi keep it simple, di way wi like it: di $PUMPUM Protocol run pon two frequency weh fit perfect — di Wood an di Pum Pum, lock in tight pon di riddim like bass pon a sound system. Reggae set di mood, trap bring di pace, an nature tek care a di rest. Tings weh slot in nice pon di beat, moon nice. Tokenomics? 100% vibes, 100% wine, 0% shame.

Cause when di riddim drop, a pon di dancefloor di wood meet di pum pum. Reggae soul, trap energy, an a likkle wine inna di dark corner. Wi nuh pretend — yuh know weh di name mean. Every beat drop bring di two togedda. So turn down di light, turn up di bass, an come een. If yuh know di vibe, yuh know exactly weh dis coin about. 😏🇯🇲🔊
